title: check: a named yes-or-no property with a witness
description: Checks: equal(a, b), zero(a), idempotent(e), orthogonal(e, f), homogeneous(a), central(z) (commutes with every generator and idempotent), primitive(e) (e A e / e J e is one-dimensional; needs a finite quotient over a field of characteristic 0).
